title: 第9章 道貌岸然狗咬狗第10章 见死不救红菱悔
content_zh:
“我倒要看看，父亲他究竟会选择谁！？”
对于祝红菱的误解与气急败坏，林玄索性闭目不理，一步步恢复着自己体内的灵力，他刚刚能感觉到，这碧潭幽谷不仅仅有一条碧潭幽蟒，自己想要取得药引，可能还需要费点功夫。
至于祝红菱对自己的看法什么的，他丝毫不在意。
“恶心！！”
何师妹见林玄闭目，啐了一句，她知道之前因为自己实力太低，连累了两位师兄，特别是对她特别关照的严师兄。
“严师兄，邱师兄，你们刚刚怎么不说话，这种人实力不行，还想冒领这么大的功劳！”
何师妹说着，知道严师兄想法，故意凑近说道：
“严师兄你没事吧，伤的这么重，要不要坐下运转功法调息一下，你不是说碧水青蛇皮对你有帮助吗？刚好祝师姐还在，可以借一下尽快恢复实力......”
祝红菱听着何师妹嗲嗲的声音，虽然略微不悦，但是她此时更为厌恶的是林玄。
“没事，还能撑得住，就是......如果真有碧水青蛇皮披着，宁神静气，恢复确实会快不少。”严师兄借驴下坡，也看着祝红菱眼色说道。
祝红菱知道严师兄惦记她的碧水青蛇皮，便说道：
“这里是碧潭幽谷内围，高阶妖兽太多了，我们应该早点离开。”
“祝师姐，我们还得回去呢，路上指不定会遇到什么妖兽，还是让两位师兄恢复一下实力比较好吧？刚刚要不是严师兄跟邱师兄，我们俩个......呜呜可能就已经葬身碧潭幽蟒腹中了......”何师妹绿茶属性再次激发了不少，本来就对她有好感的严师兄一下子就感动的不得了。
这时候旁边的邱师兄也说道：“祝师妹，你受伤也不轻，不如你也先坐下恢复恢复，我们也不急这一会回去，刚刚我跟严师弟消耗确实太多了。”
说着，邱师兄拍了拍旁边的地方，示意祝红菱坐下一起调息恢复。
祝红菱见状，几个师兄妹都想先调息恢复再走，只能点头，看着严师兄跟何师妹望来的目光，也只好把碧水青蛇皮拿出，借给严师兄。
“师妹放心，这等宝物，我恢复好后，定完好无损还你，毕竟这后面可是祝长老的东西。”严师兄拿着碧水青蛇皮，笑着打包票说道，但心里却是算着一些该怎么正大光明占为己有的道道，毕竟他师傅也是长老，地位不差于祝天虹。
就在几人闭眼盘膝调息之时，远处突然传来了一些异响。
“这是......”
几人立刻惊醒，这种匐匍爬行的声音他们太熟悉了，就是碧潭幽蟒！

“不好！这里居然不止一条碧潭幽蟒！”严师兄当即把碧水青蛇皮收好，一副严阵以待的模样。
祝红菱见状，如此万分着急之下，性命还没着落，便也不再去想碧水青蛇皮的事情。
“哧哧哧——”
这一次，陆陆续续来了好几条碧潭幽蟒，个个都是目露凶光，还有一条去了前方看着那条被林玄斩了的尸体，低着头貌似在哭泣。
“这......四五六七，好多碧潭幽蟒，呜呜......死定了，怎么办？严师兄邱师兄，我不想死呀......”
何师妹看见这么多碧潭幽蟒，吓得都哭了，躲在后面。
“每一条都是接近三阶的实力，看来是要为之前那个报仇来的。”邱师兄脸色凝重，心中暗骂我怎么知道怎么办？！
“后路被堵死了，邱师兄，严师兄，这碧潭幽蟒防御太强了，你们可还能祭出那飞剑，为我们打开一条路？”
邱师兄闻言，此时看着这么多碧潭幽蟒，还有躲在自己后面的何师妹，他真想狠狠抽自己几个嘴巴，但刚刚逞能胡诌，为什么要说个飞剑？
“祝师妹说的对，这碧潭幽蟒实在是太多了，我们必须打开一条生路逃！祝师妹，你可还有高阶符篆？”严师兄脸色也是凝重无比，开口说道。
闻言，祝红菱苦笑道：
“哪有那么多，刚刚那一张金刚伏魔符已经是父亲给我的最后一张保命之物。”
content_en:
"I want to see who my father will choose!?"
Regarding Zhu Hongling's misunderstanding and anger, Lin Xuan simply closed his eyes and restored the spiritual power in his body step by step. He could just feel that there was more than just a Bitan Nether Python in the Bitan Valley, and he might need to spend some effort to obtain the medicine.
As for Zhu Hongling's opinion of him, he didn't care at all.
"Disgusting!!"
When Junior Sister He saw Lin Xuan closing her eyes, she spat. She knew that because of her low strength, she had caused trouble to her two senior brothers, especially Senior Brother Yan, who had taken special care of her.
"Senior Brother Yan, Senior Brother Qiu, why didn't you say anything just now? This kind of person is not strong enough, but he still wants to claim such a big credit!"
Junior Sister He said, knowing what Senior Brother Yan was thinking, she deliberately came closer and said:
"Senior Brother Yan, are you okay? The injury is so serious. Do you want to sit down and exercise and adjust your breathing? Didn't you say that the blue water and green snake skin will help you? I just wish that Senior Sister is still here and can use it to regain your strength as soon as possible..."
Zhu Hongling was slightly displeased when she heard Junior Sister He's cooing voice, but she was more disgusted by Lin Xuan at this moment.
"It's okay, I can still hold on, but...if I were really covered in green snake skin, I would be calm and relaxed, and my recovery would indeed be much faster." Senior Brother Yan borrowed the donkey to go downhill and looked at Zhu Hongling and said with a wink.
Zhu Hongling knew that Senior Brother Yan was thinking about her green snake skin, so she said:
"This is the inner area of Bitan Valley. There are too many high-level monsters. We should leave early."
"Senior Sister Zhu, we have to go back. We might encounter some monsters on the way, so why not let the two senior brothers recover their strength? If it hadn't been for Senior Brother Yan and Senior Brother Qiu, the two of us... might have been buried in the belly of the Bitan Serenity Python..." Junior Sister He's green tea attributes once again inspired a lot, and Senior Brother Yan, who had a good impression of her, was suddenly moved.
At this time, Senior Brother Qiu next to him also said: "Junior Sister Zhu, your injury is not serious. Why don't you sit down and recover first? We are not in a hurry to go back now. Junior Brother Yan and I have consumed too much just now."
With that said, Senior Brother Qiu patted the place next to him and motioned Zhu Hongling to sit down and adjust his breath to recover together.
When Zhu Hongling saw this, several senior brothers and sisters wanted to adjust their breathing and recover before leaving, so they could only nod. Seeing the looks of Senior Brother Yan and Junior Sister He, she had no choice but to take out the green snake skin and lend it to Senior Brother Yan.
"Junior sister, don't worry. I will return this treasure to you intact after I recover. After all, this belongs to Elder Zhu." Senior Brother Yan took the green snake skin and said with a smile, but he was thinking about how to keep it for himself. After all, his master is also an elder, and his status is no less than that of Zhu Tianhong.
Just as a few people closed their eyes and crossed their legs to adjust their breathing, some strange noises suddenly came from the distance.
"This is..."
Several people woke up immediately. This crawling sound was all too familiar to them. It was the Bitan Nether Python!
"No! There is more than one Blue Pool Python here!" Senior Brother Yan immediately put away the green snake skin and looked ready.
Seeing this, Zhu Hongling was so anxious that her life was not yet at risk, so she no longer thought about the green snake skin.
"Chichichi——"
This time, several Bitan Pythons came one after another, all of them with fierce looks in their eyes, and one went to the front to look at the body that had been beheaded by Lin Xuan, with his head lowered and seemingly crying.
"This... four, five, six, seven, so many Bitan pythons, wuwu... they are dead, what should I do? Senior Brother Yan, Senior Brother Qiu, I don't want to die..."
When Junior Sister He saw so many Bitan Pythons, she was so frightened that she cried and hid behind them.
"Each one is close to the third level of strength. It seems that they are here to avenge the previous one." Senior Brother Qiu's face was solemn, and he secretly cursed me for knowing how.What to do? !
"The way back is blocked, Senior Brother Qiu, Senior Brother Yan, this Bitan Nether Python's defense is too strong, can you still use that flying sword to open a way for us?"
When Senior Brother Qiu heard this, he saw so many Bitan Pythons and Junior Sister He hiding behind him. He really wanted to slap himself in the face, but he just made such nonsense, why did he say a flying sword?
"Junior Sister Zhu is right, there are too many Bitan Nether Pythons, we must find a way to escape! Junior Sister Zhu, do you still have high-level talismans?" Senior Brother Yan said with a solemn expression.
Hearing this, Zhu Hongling smiled bitterly and said:
"There are not so many. The Vajra Demon-Conquering Talisman just now was the last thing my father gave me to save my life."
